01 · Intro — Why & What

Bridging the Gap in Aerospace Learning

02 / 07
WHY THIS MATTERS (THE PROBLEM)

Rocket Science Is Hard to Visualize

  • Students memorize formulas like Tsiolkovsky Δv without seeing mass, thrust, and power trade-offs live.
  • Pre-launch spoilers remove the engineering discovery of testing and diagnosing failures.
  • Professional aerospace CAD tools require heavy installs and steep training.
WHAT WE BUILT (OUR SOLUTION)

Interactive 3D Mission Lab in Your Browser

  • Walkable 3D Space HQ with Rocket & Spacecraft Assembly Workstations.
  • 5 Progressive Missions: LEO Satellite, Moon Lander, Mars Rover, ISS Docking, Jupiter Probe.
  • 15-Second Launch Loop: Audio-visual countdown, staging, and NASA post-flight debrief.
WHO: STUDENTS, EDUCATORS & SPACE BUILDERS WHERE & WHEN: INSTANTLY IN ANY BROWSER OR OFFLINE HTML

04 · NASA Open Data & Space Technology

Powered by Real NASA Data & Aerospace Physics

05 / 07
NASA CONSTANTS & ORBITAL EQUATIONS
  • Tsiolkovsky Δv: Δv = Isp · g₀ · ln(m₀ / mf), g₀ = 9.80665 m/s²
  • 1/r² Solar Flux: 1,361 W/m² (Earth) → 43% (Mars) → 3.7% (Jupiter RTGs)
  • Max-Q & DSN: 30–35 kPa peak pressure; X/Ka-Band Deep Space Network link loss
NASA BENCHMARKS & LESSONS LEARNED (LLIS)
  • Launchers: Falcon 9 Block 5, Saturn V / SLS Artemis I, Atlas V 541, Dragon 2, Voyager Titan-Centaur
  • LLIS Case Studies: Vanguard TV-3 (#0241), Mars Polar Lander (#0634), Falcon 9 CRS-7, Progress M-34 IDSS

05 · Discovery-First Pedagogy

No Pre-Launch Spoilers. Deep Post-Flight Insights.

06 / 07
1. TEST IN REAL FLIGHT

True Engineering Discovery

Designers show pure telemetry without pass/fail spoilers—launch to validate your vehicle under real mission physics.

Checks: TWR ≥ 1.02 · Max-Q · Δv · Power 1/r² · DSN Link
2. ON FAILURE: ROOT CAUSE

Cause + Solution + NASA Case

Every anomaly explains the exact physics cause, concrete hardware fix, and matching NASA LLIS historical precedent.

Example: Vanguard TV-3 (LLIS #0241) → TWR < 1.0 → Add boosters or upgrade Stage 1 engine.
3. ON SUCCESS: BENCHMARK

Real-World Comparison

Side-by-side table compares your mass, thrust, TWR, Isp, and cost against Saturn V, Falcon 9, or Atlas V.

6-Axis Score: Success · Accuracy · Fuel · Budget · Payload · Time
TEST → DIAGNOSE WITH NASA DATA → OPTIMIZE → SUCCEED INCLUDES POST-FLIGHT COST & ΔV OPTIMIZATION TIPS
